errors.evidence: The chart does not 'compare' categories in an analytical sense — it simply displays the distribution of responses. The word 'сравнява' (compares) introduces an interpretive framing not explicitly shown in the figure.

The description paraphrases the question title but does not fully convey the caption context about difficulties in applying tender documents due to lack of translation from English to Bulgarian, which the reference description implicitly captures through the figure title.
